blocks: Five unread vendor PDFs. Nothing else.
refutedOnReview: All three cited sources exist and name most of the models, but none of them says anything about a register map — the entry admits this ("Evidence given: NONE, deliberately"). Grouping five models under one dialect with zero matching register addresses is precisely what the catalogue rule forbids; "remaining consumer Genius SKUs" is a product-family argument, which the rules exclude as evidence.  I then did the outsta
gotchas: The GENIUS2X2 (4 A, 2 bank) and GENIUS2X4 (8 A, 4 bank) are multi-bank and therefore the most likely of the five to have grown an accessory port. Check those two first.
NOCO's support index also lists a GENIUS4, which does not appear in the current no.co/collection/genius product listing. Possibly discontinued or regional. Not researched.
GENIUS1 CA$49.99, GENIUS2D CA$64.99, GENIUS2X2 CA$159.99, GENIUS2X4 CA$315.99 at The Cabin Depot (checked: 2026-07-31).
